title: course.yaml
description: The course description file at courses/<id>/course.yaml. Checks the shape only; src/course.ts checks the rest (the id matches the folder, the chapters exist on disk).

chapters.description: The chapter folder names under chapters/, in course order.

free_preview.description: Chapters that visitors can read without an account. Each must also be in chapters.

name.description: An id or a folder name: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

text.description: A string with at least one character that is not white space.
